evidence: Modifies core logging utilities in src/logging.cpp and src/util/log.h to combine Warning and Error log levels into Alert.
rationale: The change simplifies the logging API across the codebase by replacing confusing and frequently misused LogError and LogWarning macros with a single LogAlert macro. As noted in issue #30348, having distinct levels whose only difference was whether the node shut down caused recurring ambiguity, making this a worthwhile internal cleanup.
